diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5 V, datasheet reading 3.6 V
diffs.evidence: The 3.6 V is the bare chip limit (Vishay datasheet doc 84276: 'Supply voltage VDD 2.5 ... 3.6 V', absolute max 3.6 V); the part models the purple 4-pin module (silkscreen '6075/6040', header VIN GND SCL SDA), whose VIN feeds an on-board regulator and level shifter. The library README for that exact board (photo extras/breakout_1_.jpg shows the purple 6075/6040 VIN/GND/SCL/SDA board) says: 'This breakout board has additional level shifting built in and can therefore be used with 5V Arduino boards. VIN of the VEML6040 to the 3.3V of your Arduino board (5V is also possible)'. So board VIN max 5 V is correct; the chip's 2.5-3.6 V limit is stated separately in the description and SKILL.md.
